task: Local no-training comparison of one small model: closed book, verified source context, lexical retrieved context
change: Only source context differs; same question, fields, system, tokenizer, weights, quantized KV and generation settings.
order: One load; per-question Latin rotation of 3arms, one generation each, seed reset42; fresh KV cache each prompt.
retrieval: Frozen FTS5 BM25; fixed RU/EN dictionary authored before exam read; top3 in visible protocol scope. Preset truncation to fit1400input; retain both candidate and delivered spans.
oracle: Verified literal source spans with180characters surrounding context; overlapping windows in the same document are merged. No expected data, answer or rationale inserted. Unknowns receive neutral document intros.
closed: No provided documents; model may answer from internal knowledge; cannot invent source IDs. Citation evidence not expected, separately reported.

metrics.content_correct: All requested substance correct, answer/data mutually consistent; assess separately from citations/serialization;60 denominator. Agent review, no human validation.
metrics.format_status_data: StrictJSON, status and typed fields separately.
metrics.known_grounded: Correct substance plus accurate supporting citation from delivered source;52 known denominator.
metrics.unknown: Correct abstention on8 not established by available input.
metrics.retrieval: Document Recall@3 and exact gold-span coverage measured separately on52known; also measure delivered context after truncation.
metrics.resources: libproc child-tree physical footprint and RSS; swap delta; host pressure; latency; actual tokens/finish reason.

resource_gate.probe: Synthetic prompt at least max_exam_input+384tokens; maxout16. Require normal pressure and successfulguard before exam.
resource_gate.on_failure: Stop owned work and preserve partial evidence. Never claim complete scores from partial arms. Do not close user apps without authorization.

cleanup: After evidence export, remove exact marked runtime lumen-local-defi-v5 including weights/venv/caches; leave intentional sources, small evidence, KS KB and Docker. No inference/report server after completion.
interpretation_limits: Local agent-authored exam, independently audited by another agent; no human validation, not an external blind benchmark.
One model size, weight precision, KV precision, language and decoding preset do not establish a capability ceiling.
Oracle context is a diagnostic upper condition, not a production retriever.
Larger corpus alone does not guarantee relevant evidence or correct reasoning.
